task_name: World 115 Task A  -  Historical Subledger Invoice Restoration, Offset JE Linking & Cross-Period Cutoff
prompt: Review the `Restored_Roofr_Invoices` and `Offset_JE_Payment_Links` schedules in `roofr_historical_ledger_diff_and_commit_audit_2026_Q3.xlsx`. Reconcile the restored Roofr subledger invoices by period (August vs. September 2026), compute the remaining open Accounts Receivable balance, and audit the offsetting Journal Entries and linked payments for proper period cutoff.

rubric.description: Computes total gross revenue across the 8 restored Roofr subledger invoices (RF-545650 through RF-545687 across commit runs CR-3667, CR-3679, CR-3680) as $78,857.71, bifurcated into $1,850.00 August 2026 (RF-545650 $1,200.00 + RF-545651 $650.00) and $77,007.71 September 2026.

Computes total remaining open Accounts Receivable balance across the restored invoices as $19,092.24, consisting of RF-545685 ($8,964.10 open on $11,952.13 billed) and RF-545673 ($10,128.14 open on $13,504.18 billed).

Computes total offsetting Journal Entries across all 4 linked payment adjustments as $12,335.12, and isolates the September 2026 offset JEs (JE-3550 $4,941.46 -> PAY-3551, JE-3581 $3,504.74 -> PAY-3582, JE-3583 $3,376.04 -> PAY-3584) at $11,822.24 vs. October 2026 JE-3579 ($512.88 -> PAY-3580 on 2026-10-09).

Enforces the period-cutoff and AR payment-linking guardrail: JE-3579 ($512.88 dated 2026-10-09) must be recognized in October 2026 rather than backdated into the reopened September 2026 close, and each offset JE must be linked to its corresponding ReceivePayment (PAY-3551, PAY-3580, PAY-3582, PAY-3584) so Customer AR and Roofing Revenue are not double-counted.
